Community Day

December Community Day 2026

Sat, Dec 12, 2026, 2:00 PM → Sun, Dec 13, 2026, 5:00 PM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

The yearly December catch-up: two days (Sat, Dec 12 and Sun, Dec 13, 2–5 p.m. local each day) bringing back Pokémon from this year's Community Days, with a different line-up each day.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

Featured Pokémon

  • Saturday: Vulpix (including Alolan Vulpix), Grookey, Scorbunny, Lechonk and Tinkatink, among others.
  • Sunday: Zorua, Pawniard, Sobble, Nickit and Frigibax, among others.

Exclusive moves

  • Evolve eligible Pokémon by 9 p.m. local time on Sunday to get the moves from their 2026 Community Days, for example Kowtow Cleave for Kingambit.

Bonuses

  • 2× Stardust and 2× Candy for catching Pokémon.
  • Up to two Special Trades a day, and trades cost 50% less Stardust.

Special Research

  • Optional paid research (US$4.99) with encounters of this year's Community Day Pokémon wearing a special background.

Tip

Pokémon from both days count for their Community Day moves until Sunday 9 p.m., so save your evolutions for the end of the weekend if you're still catching better ones.
